scripts.eval:recommend: sh -c 'rm -rf .eval-dist; tsc -p tsconfig.eval.json && node .eval-dist/lib/recommend.eval.js; status=$?; rm -rf .eval-dist; exit $status'
scripts.test:recommend: sh -c 'rm -rf .eval-dist; tsc -p tsconfig.eval.json && node --test .eval-dist/lib/recommend.eval.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .eval-dist; exit $status'
